region.rome.intro: Rome grows from a town on the Tiber into the capital of an empire. Family, patrons and money decide everything, and the poor live in cramped apartment blocks called insulae.
region.athens.intro: Athens is a city of the assembly, the theatre and the philosophers. But only male citizens vote, and many of its people are slaves or foreigners.
region.egypt.intro: Egypt lives by the rhythm of the Nile floods. Greek kings, and later the Romans, tax millions of farmers, while scholars from all over the world work in Alexandria.
